item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Increasing clouds tonight, scattered showers tomorrow
item.description: Tonight will bring increasing clouds, with a mild range of overnight lows -- mainly in the lower to mid 50s. We can expect unsettled weather over the next few days, beginning with scattered showers tomorrow.

item.title: 'I'll be back': Cast of 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' talk favorite James Cameron movie quotes
item.description: It's been 16 years since director James Cameron first took viewers to the stunning world known as Pandora. Now, all the characters are back for the third film in the franchise.

item.title: Santa Clara County sees decline in unhoused deaths for second year in a row
item.description: Advocates are preparing tombstones which represent an unhoused person who has died in Santa Clara County. South Bay leaders applaud work done to get people indoors, but know the threat is still out there, especially with bad weather approaching.

item.title: Car flies off tow truck onto BART tracks along I-580 in Castro Valley, CHP says
item.description: An unoccupied car flew off a tow truck onto the BART tracks along I-580 in Castro Valley Tuesday afternoon, according to the California Highway Patrol.

item.title: Oakland airport begins guest pass program for non-passengers to go past security
item.description: Starting this week, those non-passengers will be able to meet and greet their loved ones, drop somebody off all the way to the gate, or even just come in to OAK for a meal or a drink.

item.title: How rare drug made from group of Bay Area blood donors saves babies from botulism
item.description: It's called BabyBIG, and it's the sole antidote to botulism. It was created using antibodies from Bay Area volunteers vaccinated against botulism to help babies too young to fight the disease on their own.

item.title: Video shows Nick Reiner in gas station store, LAPD arresting him for parents' murders
item.description: Video shows Nick Reiner moments before his arrest and when he was taken into custody for the murders of his parents, director Rob Reiner and Michele Singer.

item.title: Dozens of protesters arrested after chaining themselves in front of San Francisco ICE building
item.description: At least 44 protesters were arrested after chaining themselves across the two main entrances, and others marched with signs, looking to keep the courts closed at the San Francisco ICE building.

item.title: Oakland Zoo mourning the loss of beloved giraffe Zawadi: 'Our brave, sweet boy'
item.description: The zoo announced on social media that Zawadi, a male giraffe, died on Monday. The animal care team described Zawadi as "our brave, sweet boy, who was highly intelligent, remarkably social and delighted to meet new people."

item.title: Timeline of famed director Rob Reiner and his wife Michele Singer's stabbing deaths, son's arrest
item.description: A timeline of famed director Rob Reiner and his wife Michele Singer's stabbing deaths and their son Nick Reiner's arrest.
